notes: Auth: an end-user ID token (actor user); the owner only seeds. Each case is a runQuery under a rule "allow list: if <cond>" whose filters are related to the condition; outcome OK is allow, PERMISSION_DENIED is deny. A document the query matches exists in each case.

Transactions that begin with new_transaction on the first read (BeginTransaction is refused to end users, see begin.*); the rules are those of the rules argument, a superset of f5-rules-deployed.json.
